Bihar CM Inspects Road, Extends Navratri Greetings

Bihar Chief Minister Samrat Choudhary inspected Jawaharlal Nehru Path and extended Navratri greetings to the state's residents. He began his day by performing Kalash Sthapana and worshipping Goddess Durga, before proceeding to review development work.
